title: observability: token-level cost/latency + logging/metrics dashboard and alert tuning
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Adds token-level cost & latency dashboard, KV cache logging integration, and tuned alert thresholds to reduce alert fatigue.
description: Context: Production teams have asked for finer-grained observability to diagnose cost regressions and latency spikes tied to token-level behavior and KV cache effectiveness. This PR adds a token-level cost/latency dashboard, integrates KV cache logging into our metrics pipeline, and tunes alert thresholds to reduce noisy incidents. Motivation: help SREs and Platform engineers quickly identify sources of unit-cost increases, long-tail latency, and degraded KV cache hit rates. Scope: dashboards (Grafana), metrics ingestion (Prometheus/OTel), logging (structured KV cache logs -> BigQuery), and alert rules (PagerDuty/Slack). Checklist: - [x] Add token-level cost & latency metrics emitted by runtime - [x] Wire KV cache hit/miss logging to metrics pipeline - [x] New Grafana dashboard with drilldowns by model, route, and seq_len bucket - [x] Update alert thresholds and mute flapping rules - [x] Integration tests for metric tags and dashboard panels - [x] Documentation and runbook updates Design summary: - Emit per-request token metrics: token_count, token_cost_estimate_usd, server_token_latency_ms, kv_cache_hit_rate (tags: model, route, deployment_tier, seq_len_bucket). - Prefer histogram+summary metrics for latency and cost to support p95/p99 and cost-per-token aggregation. - KV cache logging: structured logs include cache_key, hit_or_miss, kv_latency_ms, model, route; we add a small load balancer-safe sampler to capture 1% of requests for full KV traces to BigQuery. - Dashboards: a high-level summary row (overall cost, tokens/sec, avg_token_latency), per-model panels, and sequence-length heatmaps. - Alerts: tuned to p99 latency increase >20% over baseline (7d avg), token-cost-per-request increase >30% and kv_cache_hit_rate drop below 85% for >10m with >5% traffic affected. Rollout: feature-flagged runtime metric emissions and a staged dashboard rollout (alpha -> beta -> global), monitor for increased cardinality. Migration notes: we add new metric names and tags; old dashboards remain for 30 days before deprecation. Testing: unit tests for metric tagging, integration tests in perf-canary that validate metric ingestion, and manual verification in staging Grafana. Deployment: staged over three days to reduce risk. Related: complements ENG-4123 (token-cost visibility) and ENG-4199 (kv-cache telemetry).
